nodes.label: Product Purpose
nodes.rationale: Provide a live, trusted view of who is where, help groups organize routes and progress together, and make sharing achievements effortless. Success is clear situational awareness, easy coordination, and confidence while moving.

nodes.label: Design Principles
nodes.rationale: Map-first clarity over visual effects, group presence obvious at a glance, athletic/grounded progress, direct/quick/reliable actions, and strong contrast/readable text sizes.
